job_1785248673735.title: Marketing Specialist
job_1785248673735.description:
Job Summary:
We are seeking a Marketing Specialist to plan and execute marketing campaigns that drive brand awareness and lead generation.

Responsibilities:

Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns (social media, email, paid ads)
Create content for websites, social platforms, and newsletters
Analyze campaign performance and report on KPIs
Coordinate with design and content teams on marketing materials
Manage the company's social media presence
Conduct market research and competitor analysis

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field
2-3 years of experience in digital marketing
Proficiency in tools like Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, and Mailchimp
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Experience with SEO/SEM best practices

Nice to have:

Experience with Canva or Adobe Creative Suite
Familiarity with HubSpot or similar CRM/marketing platforms
